observation.command: sleep 120; echo "=== readiness via /docs ==="; ok=0; bad=""; for p in 18000 18001 18002 18003 18005 18006 18007 18008 18009 18010 18011 18012 18013 18014 18015 18016 18020 18021 18022 18024 3002; do code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 3 http://localhost:$p/docs 2>/dev/null); if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then ok=$((ok+1)); else bad="$bad $p=$code"; fi; done; echo "OK count: $ok/21"; echo "Not-200:$bad"
